page.layout: Running head top left; page number top right; one text column left with a narrow margin note column right beside it (notes at top right of the column); catchword/signature line "N las," at the foot of the text column.

main_text.p: Christianorum omnium nomine, professus est olim Hieronymus : Nos, non dico Martyrum reliquias, sed ne Solem quidem,& Lunam,non Angelos, non Archangelos, non Cherubim, non Seraphim, & omne nomen quod nominatur, & in præsenti seculo, & in futuro, colimus, & adoramus, ne seruiamus creaturæ magis, quàm Creatori, qui est benedictus in secula.Hier. ad Riparium adversf. Vigilant.
Deinde vero, vt a reliquijs ad Imagines descendamus ; Fieri nè poteft vt nobis aliquando non displiceat infana Romanæ Synagogæ superstitio? vt contra sacras Dei tabu-las,

page.notes: Page is a printed page with running head "Roma Irreconciliabilis."; the marginal note at right reads "Hier. ad Riparium adversus Vigilantium" (the notes are small italic). A faint show-through note in the right margin is not transcribed. The final line is partly cut at the foot of the column; the word "las," is the catchword-like fragment at the bottom and may be the start of "tabulas," (left in place). Some words in the column are faintly printed and uncertain, e.g. "omne nomen", "Seraphim".
